mapper.select: SELECT routeId, userId, routeName, routeType, startName, endName, totalDistance, totalDuration, riskLevel, regDt, updDt FROM ROUTES WHERE userId = #{userId} ORDER BY updDt DESC, routeId DESC
SELECT routeId, userId, routeName, routeType, startName, endName, totalDistance, totalDuration, riskLevel, regDt, updDt FROM ROUTES WHERE routeId = #{routeId}
SELECT routeStepId, routeId, stepOrder, stepType, mainText, landmark, lineName, lat, lng, distance, checkpointName, recordedYn FROM ROUTE_STEPS WHERE routeId = #{routeId} ORDER BY stepOrder
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ROUTES ( userId, routeName, routeType, startName, endName, totalDistance, totalDuration, riskLevel ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{routeName}, #{routeType}, #{startName}, #{endName}, #{totalDistance}, #{totalDuration}, #{riskLevel} )
